name: androidtui-android
description: Android and Termux support for OpenTUI. Apply the patch kit with scripts/androidtui-patch.sh and regenerate it with scripts/androidtui-regen.sh.

notes.package.json: Not patched. patches/apply-package-json.mjs makes the edits programmatically, because upstream reorders keys and bumps versions every release and a textual diff would conflict every time.
notes.prebuilt: packages/core/prebuilt/<arch>/libopentui.so is a binary build artifact, committed but never patched. Rebuild it on-device after every upstream bump — the FFI symbol set changes between releases.
notes.renderer-output.zig: The 0.4.x fork patched a dangling-temporary SIGSEGV in renderer-output.zig. Upstream 0.5.0 restructured that code (stdout is a struct field now), so the patch was dropped as obsolete.
